LanguageData.LP_StormGiantCore.label: storm giant origin
LanguageData.LP_StormGiantCore.description: The deep sea bloodline of storm giants, inherited with the race. Adults are 2.4 times the size of an ordinary person (drawn 1.55×, children grow with age); the bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee (giant-body rules) and the bigger the appetite (adult stomach ×240%); long strides, but not fast. Storm giants walk through shallow water, marsh and shallow ocean as if on flat ground. Every melee hit they land adds a bolt of thunder (15 EMP), and they can cast lightning bolt; as adults they can also summon storms. They don't care about nudity, and their fertility is only half of normal.
LanguageData.LP_StormGiantCore.customEffectDescriptio: Giant lineage: storm giant (rank 1 of the ordning, the highest).
Body size grows with age, reaching ×2.4 as an adult (drawn ×1.55).
Giant-body rules: health and melee increase with body size (adjustable in mod settings).
Giant stomach: max food rises with body size, ×240% as an adult.
Moving in water: no slowdown in shallow water, marsh and shallow ocean (deep water is still impassable).
Thunder strike: each melee hit adds 15 EMP, no cooldown.
No negative mood from nudity; can wear ordinary clothes; each piece of giant-only apparel gives mood +2 (up to +6).
LanguageData.LP_StormGiantCore.modExtensions.0.label: storm giant
LanguageData.LP_StormBody.label: body of lightning
LanguageData.LP_StormBody.description: Lightning is the storm giants' blood. EMP has no effect on them at all; lightning strike explosions (natural thunderstorms, a titan's divine punishment, lightning called by Talos-possessed, lightning a storm giant calls itself) can't hurt them.
LanguageData.LP_StormBody.customEffectDescriptions.1: Lightning strike explosions don't harm them (fires caused by lightning still burn).
LanguageData.LP_StormChild.label: child of the storm
LanguageData.LP_StormChild.description: The bigger the storm, the livelier the storm giant. When the map's weather is rain, thunderstorm, dry thunderstorm or heavy snow: melee damage +15%, move speed +10%, mood +3 (the storm is singing).
LanguageData.LP_StormChild.customEffectDescriptions.0: In rain, thunderstorms, dry thunderstorms or heavy snow: melee damage ×115%, move speed ×110%, mood +3.
LanguageData.LP_StormMelancholy.label: melancholy seer
LanguageData.LP_StormMelancholy.description: Those who can see the future are never happy. Storm giants have a constant mood -3 (heavy portents); only in the rain, or with no one else within 5 cells so they can gaze at the horizon alone, does the gloom lift.
LanguageData.LP_StormMelancholy.customEffectDescripti: Permanent mood -3; doesn't apply in rain or with nobody else within 5 cells.
LanguageData.LP_StormOmen.label: storm omen
LanguageData.LP_StormOmen.description: Storm giants can read coming disasters in the winds and clouds. With an adult storm giant on the home map, hostile raids of ≥1000 points are delayed 12 hours and a letter announces the faction and direction in advance (stacks with the Harper warning; can be turned off in mod settings).
LanguageData.LP_StormOmen.customEffectDescriptions.0: As an adult: hostile raids of ≥1000 points on the home map are delayed 12 hours and announced in advance.
LanguageData.LP_SkinStormViolet.label: pale lilac-grey skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinStormViolet.description: A storm giant's pale lilac-grey skin, like the sky before a thunderstorm.
LanguageData.LP_SkinStormTeal.label: teal skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinStormTeal.description: A storm giant's teal skin, like seawater in a storm.
LanguageData.LP_HairStormSilver.label: silver-white hair
LanguageData.LP_HairStormSilver.description: Silver-white hair, like foam on the crest of a wave.
LanguageData.LP_HairStormBlue.label: deep blue hair
LanguageData.LP_HairStormBlue.description: Deep blue hair, like the sea at the heart of a storm.
LanguageData.LP_StormCrown.label: coral thunder crown
LanguageData.LP_StormCrown.description: A storm giant's crown woven from deep sea coral, its branches carved with thunder patterns that glow faintly in the rain.
